theme: Gentle steps for creating a personal memorial service

posts.headline: A gentle welcome for guests arriving
posts.subline: Place the sign on an easel with quiet greenery
posts.pin_title: Funeral Welcome Sign Template 24x36 Soft Botanical Memorial Entrance
posts.caption:
Set a peaceful tone as loved ones enter. The 24x36 welcome sign fits a standard easel and pairs beautifully with a few sprigs of eucalyptus and a framed photo.

Find the matching kit at our shop.
posts.alt_text: A 24x36 inch soft botanical welcome sign on a wooden easel, surrounded by eucalyptus sprigs, a white candle, and a small framed photo on a light cream table.

posts.headline: Invite stories with simple memory cards
posts.subline: Set out pens and a basket for written memories
posts.pin_title: Share a Memory Card Template Printable 4.25x5.5 Soft Botanical
posts.caption:
Guests often prefer writing a quiet note. Print the 4.25x5.5 cards four to a letter sheet, fold, and place with pens and a pretty box.

The full bundle includes these cards.
posts.alt_text: Four soft botanical memory cards on a cream table beside a glass jar of pens and a woven basket for collecting written stories.

posts.headline: Print programs on regular letter paper
posts.subline: Fold the 11x8.5 sheet in half for a 5.5x8.5 booklet
posts.pin_title: Printable Funeral Program US Letter Folded 5.5x8.5 Soft Botanical
posts.caption:
No special paper needed. The 4-panel program prints on standard US Letter at home or any print shop. Fold once and you're done.

See the kit in our shop.
posts.alt_text: A printed 11x8.5 inch landscape sheet with soft botanical design, folded in half to show the finished 5.5x8.5 inch 4-panel program booklet.

posts.headline: Fill in the program on your phone
posts.subline: Open in free Adobe Reader tap type save print
posts.art_prompt: a soft watercolor scene with sage leaves, cream paper textures, and gentle morning light, empty space in center for text overlay
posts.caption:
The fill-in PDF opens in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app. Tap each field, type your details, save, and print. No account, no subscription.

Link in bio for the kit.
posts.alt_text: A phone screen showing the Soft Botanical program cover open in Adobe Reader, with a finger tapping a fillable name field, sage and cream watercolor background.
posts.video_script: Hook: You can personalize the whole program right from your phone. Beat 1: Show downloading the PDF and opening in Adobe Reader app. Beat 2: Tap a sample name field, type a new name, watch it stay perfectly aligned. Beat 3: Tap Save, then Print — choose home printer or send to Staples. Close: It takes two minutes. The kit is linked in bio.

posts.headline: From sample text to personal story
posts.subline: Two minutes of typing creates a keepsake program
posts.art_prompt: a soft watercolor scene with pressed sage leaves, folded cream paper, warm candlelight, empty center space for text
posts.caption:
The template comes with gentle placeholder wording. Replace each line with your loved one's details, a favorite poem, the order of service.

Find the bundle in our shop.
posts.alt_text: Split view: left side shows the Soft Botanical program cover with sample text; right side shows the same cover personalized with a name, dates, photo placeholder, and custom order of service.
posts.video_script: Hook: Watch a template become a tribute in two minutes. Beat 1: Show the cover with sample text — 'Name', 'Dates', 'Order of Service'. Beat 2: Fast-forward typing: a name appears, dates, a short reading, a hymn title. Beat 3: The finished cover with a photo added on desktop, ready to print. Close: Every field is yours to fill. Link in bio.
